title: This Totally Kicks Axe!
description: This Totally Kicks Axe! — The Townstons wiki
html:
This Totally Kicks Axe!
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  Rainbow Item
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

This Totally Kicks Axe! is a fighter rainbow item.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. Primaries roll as a Strength / Agility / Endurance mix. That roll is the joke ending on Mythic Suffixes.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.
  • Crit: melee crit chance. Random.
  • Damage: slashing damage %. Random.
  • Health / mana: health, mana, or both. Random.
  • Resists: a pair or triple that is not ice.
  • Resists: a pair or triple that is not poison.
  • Resists: a pair or triple that is not shadow.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.
